title: Factorization of the two explicit raw pullbacks
statement: For Λ commutative, k:W→S, G a module sheaf, q a natural degree, U etale over S, A,B over W and f:A→B, the module raw pullback of z equals moduleSourceFactor followed by derived inverse image of z followed by moduleCoefficientFactor. Independently, for every abelian raw class x on B, its abelian raw pullback equals abelianSourceFactor followed by derived inverse image of x followed by abelianCoefficientFactor. No relation between z and x is assumed.

source.place: Tags 03FD and 03Q8; explicit raw-map formula expansion

proof.text: Evaluate higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor.map via higherDirectImageRawOverPullbackHom_apply and expand higherDirectImageRawOverPullback and higherDirectImageRawTrianglePullback. The first two factors are moduleSourceFactor and the last two are moduleCoefficientFactor. Associativity joins the first two, leaving the derived image of z in the middle. Expand abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback on the arbitrary abelian class x. Its first two factors are abelianSourceFactor and its last two are abelianCoefficientFactor, so the same associativity equation gives the second identity. These are formulas for the two maps separately; scalar comparison, its coherence and any relationship between z and x are not used. All zero and identity cases follow from the same expansions.

theorem rawModuleScalar_pullback_formulas
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ) (U : S.Etale)
    (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B)
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).obj (op B)) :
    ((higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).map f.op z =
      moduleSourceFactor Λ f.left (B.hom ≫ k) (A.hom ≫ k)
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, Over.w]) ((freeSheaf Λ S).obj U) ≫
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map z ≫
        moduleCoefficientFactor Λ G (q : ℤ) A B f) ∧
    (∀ (x : (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf (B.hom ≫ k) q
      (restrictedOverCoefficient ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ W).obj G) B)).obj
        (op U)),
      abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback f.left (B.hom ≫ k) (A.hom ≫ k)
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, Over.w]) q _ _
        ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f.left B.hom A.hom
          (Over.w f).symm).inv.app ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ W).obj G)) U x =
      abelianSourceFactor f.left (B.hom ≫ k) (A.hom ≫ k)
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, Over.w]) (RawModuleScalarComparison.freeAbelian S U) ≫
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map x ≫
      abelianCoefficientFactor ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ W).obj G)
        (q : ℤ) A B f)
